payloads.title: Shield Investment Filigree
payloads.text: At start of combat and after Stall (20), spend 1 Shard to apply lasting Shields to all Heroes, then permanently increase the amount of Shields this applies by 50.

payloads.title: Shard Maximizer
payloads.text: Gain interest on saved Shards. At the end each combat, gain 1 additional Shard per 5 Shards in your bank (Max: 20. Does not count towards generation).

payloads.title: Shard Ascendancy
payloads.text: Generate 25 Shards.

payloads.title: Shard Precision Prism
payloads.text: Heroes gain Crit equal to the number of Shards in bank (Max: 1000).

payloads.title: Poison Migrator
payloads.text: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer their Poison to the nearest enemy.

payloads.title: Poison Ascendancy
payloads.text: Inflict 400 Poison.

payloads.title: Blight Resonance Prism
payloads.text: Whenever an enemy takes Poison or Burn damage, heal all adjacent Heroes to them for 50% of that damage.

payloads.title: Frost Migrator
payloads.text: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer their Frost to the nearest enemy.

payloads.title: Frost Ascendancy
payloads.text: Inflict 800 Frost.

payloads.title: Glacial Guard Prism
payloads.text: Whenever a Hero inflicts Frost, they gain 6 Shields per Frost inflicted.

payloads.title: Burn Migrator
payloads.text: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer their Burn to the nearest enemy.

payloads.title: Burn Ascendancy
payloads.text: Inflict 1200 Burn.

payloads.title: Thermal Inverter
payloads.text: Whenever a Hero inflicts Burn, also inflict 50% of the Burn applied as Frost.Whenever a Hero inflicts Frost, also inflict 50% of the Frost applied as Burn.

payloads.title: Plague Velocitizer
payloads.text: Every 4 seconds, Heroes gain 1 Attack Speed and 2 Attack per type of Debuff on all enemies.

payloads.title: Plague Ascendancy
payloads.text: Inflict 25 Poison, 50 Frost, and 75 Burn on a single enemy.

payloads.title: Arcane Backup Prism
payloads.text: Heroes gain 20 Magic per rank of each Mage in the reserves and 2 Mana Regen per rank of each Mystic in the reserves.

payloads.title: Martial Backup Prism
payloads.text: Heroes gain 10 Crit per rank of each Assassin in the reserves, 15 Attack Speed per rank of each Duelist in the reserves, and 20 Attack per rank of each Warrior in the reserves.

payloads.title: Defensive Backup Prism
payloads.text: Heroes gain 30 Defense per rank of each Tank in the reserves and 200 Max HP per rank of each Vanguard in the reserves.

payloads.title: Momentous Differentiator
payloads.text: Heroes gain 2 Attack Speed for each time you've rerolled the shop this game.

payloads.title: Stalwart Differentiator
payloads.text: Heroes gain 3 Defense for each time you've rerolled the shop this game.

payloads.title: Alignment Ascendancy
payloads.text: Trigger Rush or Stall 25 times.

payloads.title: Reputation Ascendancy
payloads.text: Win a combat with a C-Rank, B-Rank, and A-Rank hero on your team.

payloads.title: Golden Ascendancy
payloads.text: Win a combat with 66 or more Shards in your bank.

payloads.title: Reserve Ascendancy
payloads.text: Win a combat with 2 Heroes in your reserves.

payloads.title: Shard Energy Velocitizer
payloads.text: Heroes gain 1 Attack Speed per 5 Shards you've generated this game.

payloads.title: Warrior's Bloodshield Engine
payloads.text: Heroes gain 50 Attack.Whenever a Warrior deals damage, they gain lasting Shields equal to 15% of the damage dealt.

payloads.title: Tank's Absolution Engine
payloads.text: Heroes gain 60 Defense.Every 8 times a Tank is auto attacked, Stun that attacking enemy for 1.5 seconds.

payloads.title: Vanguard's Titanic Engine
payloads.text: Heroes gain 400 Max HP.Whenever a Vanguard auto attacks or is auto attacked, they gain 10 Max HP. Every 200 Max HP gained this way, give them 25 Attack and increase their size.

payloads.title: Assassin's Ambush Engine
payloads.text: Heroes gain 30 Crit.Whenever an Assassin auto attacks while Stealthed, they inflict Poison on their target equal to 75% of their Crit.At start of combat, Assassins in the back 2 rows gain Stealth for 5 seconds and target the most threatening enemy.

payloads.title: Duelist's Momentum Engine
payloads.text: Heroes gain 40 Attack Speed.Whenever a Duelist auto attacks, they deal 5 bonus damage for each time they have auto attacked this combat.

payloads.title: Mystic's Abundance Engine
payloads.text: Heroes gain 8 Mana Regen.Whenever a Mystic Shields a Hero, give that Hero lasting Shields equal to 50% of the Shield applied.

payloads.title: Mage's Cataclysm Engine
payloads.text: Heroes gain 50 Magic.Whenever a Mage casts, they inflict Burn and Frost on all enemies in their range equal to 20% of their Magic.

payloads.title: Slaughter Mandate
payloads.text: Deal 15000 damage with auto attacks.

payloads.title: Arcane Mandate
payloads.text: Deal 15000 damage with active abilities.

payloads.title: Shelter Mandate
payloads.text: Apply 30000 Shields.

payloads.title: Merchant Mandate
payloads.text: Reroll the shop 9 times, then complete a combat.

payloads.title: Dominion Mandate
payloads.text: Inflict 5000 Debuffs.

payloads.title: Unity Mandate
payloads.text: Win a combat with 4 or more heroes of the same class in combat or in the reserves.

payloads.title: Omnity Mandate
payloads.text: Win a combat with a Hero of all 7 classes in combat or in the reserves.

payloads.title: Greed Mandate
payloads.text: Win a combat with 100 or more Shards in your bank.

payloads.title: Deceleration Mandate
payloads.text: Trigger Stall 25 times.

payloads.title: Acceleration Mandate
payloads.text: Trigger Rush 25 times.

payloads.title: Critical Singularity
payloads.text: At start of combat, each Hero with less than 150 Crit has their Crit set to 150. Each Hero with 150 or more Crit has their Attack Speed, Attack, and Magic set to 150 if they had less than 150 of those stats.

payloads.title: Shield Fragmentation Engine
payloads.text: Whenever an enemy damages a Hero's Shields, deal 200% of the damage back to the source.

payloads.title: Venom Amplification Engine
payloads.text: Whenever an enemy takes 50 or more damage from Poison, they also take damage equal to 4% of their Max HP.

payloads.title: Glacial Decay Engine
payloads.text: Frost now deals damage to enemies when it ticks down (like Burn does).

payloads.title: Burning Spiral Engine
payloads.text: Whenever an enemy with 100 or more Burn dies, damage all enemies in a large area around them equal to 50% of their Max HP.

payloads.title: Plague Transmission Engine
payloads.text: At start of combat and every 10 seconds, inflict 10 Poison, 20 Frost, and 30 Burn on all enemies.

payloads.title: Deceleration Legacy Crystal
payloads.text: After Stall (45), Heroes gain +1% basic stats for every 2 times you've triggered Stall this game.

payloads.title: The Riftbreaker
payloads.text: After Stall (90), break the rift.

payloads.title: Acceleration Legacy Crystal
payloads.text: For Rush (6), Heroes gain +1% basic stats for every 2 times you've triggered Rush this game.

payloads.title: Godspeed Ascension Engine
payloads.text: For Rush (1), Heroes gain +150% basic stats.

payloads.title: Shard Power Extractor
payloads.text: On Shards generated, deal damage to all enemies equal to 10% of their Max HP (Minimum: 2500 damage).

payloads.title: Rift Storm Invoker
payloads.text: The Rift Storm starts 30 seconds sooner. Heroes take 100% reduced damage from The Rift Storm.

payloads.title: Temporal Alignment Crystal
payloads.text: On Stall trigger, deal 8 damage to all enemies for each Rush you've triggered this game.On Rush trigger, give 8 lasting Shields to all Heroes for each Stall you've triggered this game.

payloads.title: Victory Mandate
payloads.text: Win 4 combats.

payloads.title: Ascension Mandate
payloads.text: Win a combat with Heroes of 3 or more different ranks in combat.

payloads.title: Critical Mandate
payloads.text: Crit 200 times.

payloads.title: Temporal Mandate
payloads.text: Trigger Rush or Stall 40 times.

payloads.title: Desperation Mandate
payloads.text: Win a combat with only 1 surviving Hero.

payloads.title: Defensive Energy Crystal
payloads.text: At start of combat, Tanks and Vanguards gain Shields equal to 100% of their Max HP.After Stall (20 and Stall 40), Tanks and Vanguards gain Shields equal to 1000% of their Defense.

payloads.title: Martial Energy Crystal
payloads.text: Auto attacks by Assassins, Duelists, and Warriors gain 100 Crit.

payloads.title: Arcane Energy Crystal
payloads.text: Whenever a Mage or Mystic casts, they deal damage equal to 100% of their Magic to all enemies and apply Shields equal to 1000% of their Mana Regen to all Heroes.

payloads.title: Heroic Capacity Expander
payloads.text: Heroes can equip an additional item (Max: 5).

payloads.title: Omnity Enforcer
payloads.text: Get all 7 Crests. Crests are items which make a Hero count as having an additional class during combat.

payloads.title: Harmony Crystal
payloads.text: Increase your team size by 1 (Max: 5).

payloads.title: The Debtor
payloads.text: Earn 5 fewer Shards for combat victory.

payloads.title: Starter Bundle
payloads.text: Gain a random common item, a random common relic, and 5 Shards.

payloads.title: Bossy

payloads.title: Quantity over Quality

payloads.title: Vampirism

payloads.title: Stability System

payloads.title: Quality over Quantity

payloads.title: Legacy Charm
